description: This file declares internal API functions for managing an object array, specifically function prototypes for array operations such as get size, set size, remove all, get at, set at, insert at, remove at, add, enlarge storage, and find. It is part of the Ansc Object Array component within the CCSP Common Library related to the UInt Array object.

methods.name: AnscPtrArrayGetSize
methods.description: Returns the current size of the object array.

methods.name: AnscPtrArraySetSize
methods.description: Sets the size of the object array, with options to specify growth factor.

methods.name: AnscPtrArrayRemoveAll
methods.description: Removes all elements from the object array.

methods.name: AnscPtrArrayGetAt
methods.description: Retrieves the data at a specified index in the array.

methods.name: AnscPtrArraySetAt
methods.description: Sets the data at a specific index in the array.

methods.name: AnscPtrArrayInsertAt
methods.description: Inserts data at a specific index in the array, shifting subsequent elements.

methods.name: AnscPtrArrayRemoveAt
methods.description: Removes a specified number of elements starting from a given index.

methods.name: AnscPtrArrayAdd
methods.description: Appends data to the end of the array.

methods.name: AnscPtrArrayEnlargeStorage
methods.description: Enlarges the storage capacity of the array to accommodate more elements.

methods.name: AnscPtrArrayFind
methods.description: Searches for data in the array and returns its index if found.
